notes.title: ULTRA MEGA UPDATE \o/
notes.content:
After hearing more feedbacks from the players, I bring you another update balancing the game, fixing bugs, and many other news! Check it out!

- Removed the DEMO version and change the game to FREE

- Added new allies 

- Added new skills, equipments, and combos

- Added new traits to be bought on the Shop

- Difficulty balance

- Minors bugs fixed

- Added FullScreen mode

- Released on Play Store

- Added Portuguese language option

- Improved some attacks, maps, and game flow as well!

Hope you enjoy! Have a nice gameplay [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35766424/0f22ac89b8a12947e3586e40404961a1475ea040.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35766424/87e07986e67f2e07ac6da611f4457a7571dea833.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: UPDATE \o/
notes.content: New update that fixes minor bugs, improves gameplay, and implements new features!     Here are some of the changes:      - Implemented a Main Menu to access all the game's functions, configs, and shortcuts     - Improved allies AI      - Improved game performance, with a new AI system that balances graphics and effects  during gameplay      - Tutorial stage improvement      - Most suitable balancing in easy mode      - Improved game tips so that the player does not get lost during gameplay      in addition, other minor improvements were made to the game.     Hope you like it!   [b]Have a nice gameplay![/b]  [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35766424/0f22ac89b8a12947e3586e40404961a1475ea040.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35766424/87e07986e67f2e07ac6da611f4457a7571dea833.png[/img][/url]
